# CP2K fixtures

| File | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `si.inp` | Unmodified copy of `httk-workflow-cp2k/tests/data/si.inp`: a CP2K 2026.2 input generated by this project (8-atom conventional cubic diamond Si, `ABC`/`ALPHA_BETA_GAMMA` cell, `SCALED` coordinates). |
| `feo-1.restart` | Synthetic, hand-made file in the layout of a CP2K `.restart` file (restart files use the input syntax): `A`/`B`/`C` cell vectors, Cartesian Å coordinates, `MULTIPLE_UNIT_CELL 1 1 1`, a `&KIND` with `ELEMENT` and one with an inline `&POTENTIAL`. It is not CP2K output. |
